fold_theory.formal: FrakturF = (F_K, M_F, E_F, delta_Pi, B, Exe)
fold_theory.F_K: Fold Space: discrete navigable state space
fold_theory.M_F: Fold Field: typed incidence/potential field over Fold Space

fold_field.definition: field defined over Fold topology, optionally admitting continuous geometric projections
fold_field.projection_law: Pi_R(M_F) is a representation; projection is not the object
fold_field.gradient_law: gradient_Q(M_F) is candidate navigation pressure, not legal direction

event_law.event_is_not: transition authority, semantic truth, or topology commit by itself
event_law.competence_boundary: N-Gram Burner may emit EVENT_COMPETENCE_CANDIDATE; XCFE must authorize an upgrade
event_law.topology_boundary: delta_B != 0 requires Verified && Authorized && Fresh && Xul

invariants.FE2: EVENT_SHIFT_TRACK changes T while preserving phase
invariants.FE3: EVENT_CYCLE_PHASE advances phi by one C6 step while preserving track
invariants.FE4: EVENT_FOLD_STATE and EVENT_OSCILLATE_DENSITY toggle s while preserving phase and track
invariants.FE5: EVENT_COMPETENCE_CANDIDATE proposes sigma movement but does not authorize it
invariants.FE7: EVENT_FIELD_GRADIENT is field_projection only; gradient is candidate navigation pressure
invariants.FE8: EVENT_TOPOLOGY_CANDIDATE may propose delta_B but cannot commit topology
invariants.FE9: EVENT_TOPOLOGY_COMMIT requires delta_B and Verified && Authorized && Fresh && Xul
invariants.FE11: p_next = delta_XCFE(p_t, e_t, Pi); event records do not decide transitions
invariants.FE12: evidence fields are nonnegative and confidence is in [0,1]
invariants.FE13: EVENT_FIELD_GRADIENT may carry a FoldField record; fold_field.score() = W·C·R is navigation pressure, not route authority
invariants.FE14: product graph edge weight = W_arc·cos(Δθ); FoldField vertex encodes (node_id,theta,W,C,R) for G_runtime scoring

fold_field_integration.FoldField_is: vertex in G_runtime = G_semantic □ G_phase: (node_id, theta, W, C, R)
fold_field_integration.relation_to_events: EVENT_FIELD_GRADIENT carries fold_field scoring; event is candidate, not authority
fold_field_integration.product_graph_edge: w(a,b) = W_arc·cos(θ_b − θ_a); approximate form uses √(Wa·Wb) when W_arc unavailable
